meta.name: comment-checker
meta.description: Use when Codex needs to understand or respond to automatic comment-checker feedback emitted after an edit-like PostToolUse hook.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 理解并回应代码审查的自动反馈
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在编辑代码后处理自动审查反馈。
copy.tagline_en: Understand and respond to automatic code review feedback
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to handle automatic review feedback after editing code.

howto.what: 装上后,Codex每次成功修改文件后,会自动运行注释检查器。若检查器发出警告,Codex必须修复或解释被标记的注释再继续;若检查器程序缺失,则不产生输出,流程照常。
howto.when: 在Codex成功执行apply_patch、write、edit等编辑操作后触发;若注释检查器报告警告,Codex会收到阻塞性反馈。非编辑工具被忽略。

say.text: 修复注释检查器标记的注释。
say.note: Codex将调整该注释以消除警告。

say.text: 解释这条注释为什么被标记。
先处理所有检查器警告再继续。
say.note: 确保没有遗留的注释问题。

howto.what_en: After installation, successful file edits trigger the comment checker. If it warns, Codex must fix or explain the flagged comment before continuing. If the checker binary is missing, no output is produced and work proceeds normally.
howto.when_en: Triggered after successful apply_patch, write, edit, etc. Non-edit tools are ignored. If the checker warns, Codex receives blocking feedback.

say_en.text: Fix the comment flagged by the checker.
say_en.note: Codex will adjust it to clear the warning.

say_en.text: Explain why this comment was flagged.
Address all checker warnings before moving on.
